title: hax-network-bar
description: The top bar of every site in the HAX network: an icon for every property, your character, Merlin to jump anywhere, and Install HAX with every way to get it

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: Which site this is: web, try, learn, elements, cloud or rpg (what it was called before, browser and docs, still works).

attributes.name: character
attributes.description: Your character, after the properties, as an rpg-character code (RPG me makes one). Empty draws HAX's own.

attributes.name: install-method
attributes.description: The way to install whose tab is open; empty is the first

attributes.name: menu-open
attributes.description: The sites menu is open (narrow screens)

attributes.name: demo
attributes.description: A HAXcms demo with no backend (demo.hax.cloud, the haxcms-elements demo): the mini bar (as compact) with a notice that nothing is saved, pinned above the HAXcms editor bar. It keeps --haxcms-top-offset on the page set to its height so the editor bar sits under it.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: The mini bar, for a page whose editor already has Merlin and the Future Traveler (HAXcms in the browser): shorter, with the same property icons but no character, Merlin or Future Traveler of its own, and the pre slot in the middle for the page's own status and functions.

attributes.name: has-pre
attributes.description: the mini bar's pre slot holds something (a page's own controls)

attributes.name: traveler-era
attributes.description: The era the Future Traveler is drawn in: now, steam, nouveau, deco, tomorrow, rainbow, stripes, neon, handheld, web, polygon or terminal (HAX_TRAVELER_ERAS in lib/hax-future-traveler.js).
